name: dth-sfp
title: Digital Transformation Handbook for Reporting Substandard and Falsified Medical Products

directories.description: The working document of the DTH on reporting substandard and falsified medical products: its document, chapters and blocks (prose, figures, tables, personas, user scenarios, business processes, data elements, functional and non-functional requirements, indicators, and decision tables), seeded from the L1 entry who-iris/library/9789240120747-eng by its contents-page outline.

The six executable BPMN 2.0 workflows (SF-REP-001 through SF-REP-006) for reporting, acknowledging, investigating, taking regulatory action, reporting to WHO GSMS, and offline synchronisation of suspected substandard and falsified medical products.

The handbook's own substandard and falsified medical product reporting terms (Cluster C of dth-sfp#1 §2.1) as a folio-glossary/v1 SKOS scheme. Each term quotes the handbook's definition or passage with its L1 page, and links via SKOS broader/closeMatch/broadMatch/related to the smart-ra (dpi-h-ra), dth-sc, dth-pc, or dth-hrh concept it narrows or relates to.

The dth-sfp ArchiMate overlay on the smart-ra (DPI-H RA) model, one folder per SemVer version, named by archimate/cat-archimate.config.json. A DTH builds an overlay and does not add to smart-ra (owner, 2026-11-01, Q-RA1 A; dth-sfp#7): elements tagged overlay:base copy a smart-ra element, elements tagged overlay:dth copy a dth-phc overlay element, elements tagged overlay:owner=dth-sfp are this DTH's own. scripts/archimate/extract_overlay.py built 0.1.0-draft.1 from the SFP work once in smart-ra#182.
Inbox for material not yet ingested.
This instance's work plan — one Markdown file per bean, managed with the `beans` CLI (`.beans.yml`).
People's outstanding items and the feedback raised against blocks; its inner directories are declared by `todos/todos.json`.

description: WHO Digital transformation handbook for reporting substandard and falsified medical products (2026, ISBN 9789240120747, IRIS 187cabc7), as an L2 DTH on smart-ra, dth-sc, dth-pc, dth-hrh, and smart-base: the working document folio seeded from its L1 entry in who-iris (9789240120747-eng), DAK components (personas, user scenarios, BPMN 2.0 workflows, DMN 1.3 decision tables, core data elements, requirements, and indicators), and its Cluster C domain glossary linked to smart-ra, dth-sc, dth-pc, and dth-hrh.
_needs_comment: An L2 DTH on smart-ra, dth-sc, dth-pc, dth-hrh, smart-base, and who-iris (owner, 2026-10-31, dth-sfp#1 §2.0–§2.4): its glossary terms, personas, data elements, BPMN processes, DMN decision tables, and narrative link to dpi-h-ra (litlfred/smart-ra) glossary concepts and ArchiMate 0.3.0-draft.1 elements/views, dth-sc supply chain terms, dth-pc product catalogue terms, dth-hrh health workforce occupation terms, smart-base DAK block kinds, and who-iris L1 source 9789240120747-eng.
